subtitle.ja: ドームいっぱいに、世界の空を渡る約五分の遊覧飛行
subtitle.en: A five-minute flight over the world, filling the screen

summary.ja: 座席ごと浮かび上がるドーム型アトラクションを、ブラウザの全画面で。夜明けの雲の上から、雪の尖峰、大瀑布、珊瑚の海、赤い峡谷、オーロラの氷海、そして花火の中をくぐり抜ける夜の港へ。風景はすべてGPUでその場で描き、場面ごとに曲調の変わるピアノ曲と、滝や波の音もすべて合成。日本語と英語に対応。
summary.en: A dome-screen flight ride, in a browser, full screen. From the clouds at dawn over an ice spire, great falls, a coral atoll, a red canyon and an aurora over the ice, to a night harbor where you fly through the fireworks. Every landscape is ray-marched live on the GPU; the solo piano score, which changes with each place, and the sound of the water are synthesised. Japanese and English.
